        <script><![CDATA[var MSSCustodyOnDemandCallUtils = Class.create();
MSSCustodyOnDemandCallUtils.prototype = Object.extendsObject(global.AbstractAjaxProcessor, {

    //MSSOTIQUBE-1816 && //MSSCUSTODY-6650 //MSSOTIQUBE-2982
    refreshTradeDataAPICall: function(uiActionTriggerTime) {
		
        try {
            //1st precedence to API call
            var eventOnDemandenv = gs.getProperty('x_hsb11_mss_custod.eventCustodyonDemand_uri');
            var mssonDemandToken = gs.getProperty('x_hsb11_mss_custod.hsbcmss_EventLayercustodyonDemand_api_token');
            var requestBody = 'HSBCTransactionIdentifications=' + encodeURIComponent(current.trade_id);
            var restMessageTradeData = new sn_ws.RESTMessageV2('MSS OnDemand API Send', 'Get');
            restMessageTradeData.setStringParameterNoEscape('event_OnDemand_env', eventOnDemandenv);
            restMessageTradeData.setStringParameterNoEscape('mssOnDemand_token', mssonDemandToken);
            restMessageTradeData.setStringParameterNoEscape('requestbody', requestBody);
            restMessageTradeData.setEccCorrelator(current.sys_id);
            restMessageTradeData.executeAsync();

            //2nd precedence to staging table record creation
            var createProcessonDemand = new GlideRecord('x_hsb11_mss_custod_mss_custody_unity_ondemand_staging');
            createProcessonDemand.initialize();
            createProcessonDemand.request_body = 'HSBCTransactionIdentifications=' + encodeURIComponent(current.trade_id);
            createProcessonDemand.state = 'Processsing';
            //createProcessonDemand.trade_id = current.sys_id;
            createProcessonDemand.trade_base = current.sys_id; //Custody Redesign
            createProcessonDemand.request_date = new GlideDateTime();
            createProcessonDemand.refresh_start_time = uiActionTriggerTime;
            createProcessonDemand.insert();
        } catch (exp) {
            gs.info("Script Include - MSSCustodyOnDemandCallUtils - Unexpected error while processing" + exp.message);
        }
    },

    //MSSCUSTODY-6650//MSSOTIQUBE-2982
    refreshTradeDataClientAPICall: function() {

        try {
            var tradeID = this.getParameter('sysparm_tradeID');
            var tradeSysID = this.getParameter('sysparm_tradeSysID');

            var createRec = new global.hsbcTimeUtils().evalIfStagingRecordAvailable(tradeSysID);

            if (createRec) {
                //to cover the on_load refresh in Active Trade and also Historical Trade form
                var baseTrade = new GlideRecord('sn_bom_trade');
                if (baseTrade.get(tradeSysID)) {
                    var grTrade = new GlideRecord(baseTrade.sys_class_name);
                    grTrade.get(tradeSysID);
                    grTrade.attribute_sync = 'Attribute Sync is in Progress';
                    grTrade.update();
                }

                var eventOnDemandenv = gs.getProperty('x_hsb11_mss_custod.eventCustodyonDemand_uri');
                var mssonDemandToken = gs.getProperty('x_hsb11_mss_custod.hsbcmss_EventLayercustodyonDemand_api_token');
                var requestBody = 'HSBCTransactionIdentifications=' + encodeURIComponent(tradeID.toString());
                var restMessageTradeData = new sn_ws.RESTMessageV2('MSS OnDemand API Send', 'Get');
                restMessageTradeData.setStringParameterNoEscape('event_OnDemand_env', eventOnDemandenv);
                restMessageTradeData.setStringParameterNoEscape('mssOnDemand_token', mssonDemandToken);
                restMessageTradeData.setStringParameterNoEscape('requestbody', requestBody);
                restMessageTradeData.setEccCorrelator(tradeSysID.toString());
                restMessageTradeData.executeAsync();

                //2nd precedence to staging table record creation
                var createProcessonDemand = new GlideRecord('x_hsb11_mss_custod_mss_custody_unity_ondemand_staging');
                createProcessonDemand.initialize();
                createProcessonDemand.request_body = 'HSBCTransactionIdentifications=' + encodeURIComponent(tradeID);
                createProcessonDemand.state = 'Processsing';
                //createProcessonDemand.trade_id = tradeSysID;
                createProcessonDemand.trade_base = tradeSysID;
                createProcessonDemand.request_date = new GlideDateTime();
                createProcessonDemand.refresh_start_time = new GlideDateTime();
                createProcessonDemand.insert();
            }

        } catch (exp) {
            gs.info("Error from Script Include MSSCustodyOnDemandCallUtils - refreshTradeDataClientAPICall " + exp.message);
        }

    },

    //MSSOTIQUBE-1813
    refreshSwiftMessageAPICall: function() {
        //Passed trade_id even when calling from task
        var tradeSysId = this.getParameter("sysparm_id");
        var tradeAttribute = this.getParameter("sysparm_attribute_sync");


        if (tradeAttribute == "Attribute Sync is in progress")
            return "Attribute Sync is in progress";
        var refresh_start = new GlideDateTime();
        try {
            var reqBodySI;
            var TradeRecord = new GlideRecord("x_hsb11_mss_c_proc_mss_custody_trade");
            if (TradeRecord.get(tradeSysId)) {
                if (TradeRecord.source_system == "GHSS" || TradeRecord.source_system == "GCS") //Completed API call
                    reqBodySI = 'hsbcTransactionIdentification=' + encodeURIComponent(TradeRecord.trade_id) + '&messageProcessingStatus=completed';
                else
                    reqBodySI = 'messageSourceIdentification=' + encodeURIComponent(TradeRecord.trade_id) + '&owningBusinessName=' + encodeURIComponent(TradeRecord.owning_business.toString()) + '&messageSourceSystemName=' + TradeRecord.source_system;
            }
            // FOr GHSS and GCS we have comp event prev. format for reqBody as given above
            // For anyother source we have swift_reje event . format as above..
            TradeRecord.swift_attribute_sync = "Attribute Sync is in progress";
            TradeRecord.update();
            var swiftOnDemandenv = gs.getProperty('x_hsb11_mss_c_swft.hsbcmss_el_custodySwiftonDemand_api_url');
            var mssSwiftonDemandToken = gs.getProperty('x_hsb11_mss_c_swft.hsbcmss_el_custodySwiftonDemand_api_token');
            var restMessageSwiftData = new sn_ws.RESTMessageV2('x_hsb11_mss_c_swft.MSS Swift OnDemand API Send', 'Fetch Swift Messages');
            restMessageSwiftData.setStringParameterNoEscape('mssSwiftOnDemand_token', mssSwiftonDemandToken);
            restMessageSwiftData.setStringParameterNoEscape('eventoutbound_base_uri', swiftOnDemandenv);
            restMessageSwiftData.setStringParameterNoEscape('requestbody', reqBodySI);
            var agentCorrelator = TradeRecord.sys_id + "/TradeForm";
            restMessageSwiftData.setEccCorrelator(agentCorrelator);
            restMessageSwiftData.executeAsync();


            //After the API Call we need to add the record in the staging table -1813 MSSOTIUQBE
            var createSwiftOnDemand = new GlideRecord('x_hsb11_mss_c_swft_mss_custody_swift_ondemand_staging');
            createSwiftOnDemand.initialize();
            createSwiftOnDemand.refresh_start_time = refresh_start;

            createSwiftOnDemand.trade_reference = tradeSysId;
            createSwiftOnDemand.request_body = reqBodySI;
            createSwiftOnDemand.insert();


        } catch (apiCallErr) {
            gs.info("1813 - Script Include - MSSCustodyOnDemandCallUtils (Refresh Swift) - Unexpected error while processing" + apiCallErr.message);
        }
    },

    //MSSOTIQUBE-1902,2042
    refreshPositionDataAPICall: function() {

        var tradeSysId = this.getParameter("sysparm_id");
        var tradeAttribute = this.getParameter("sysparm_attribute_sync");
        if (tradeAttribute == "Attribute Sync is in progress")
            return "Attribute Sync is in progress";

        var refresh_start_time = new GlideDateTime();


        var TradeRecord = new GlideRecord("x_hsb11_mss_c_proc_mss_custody_trade");
        if (TradeRecord.get(tradeSysId)) {
            if (TradeRecord.securities_account == '' || TradeRecord.security_id == '') {
                return "security account or security id is empty";
            } else { //API Call
                //DeLink all existing Position Details with this Trade ID
                var positionDetail = new GlideRecord("x_hsb11_mss_pos_custody_positions_details");
                positionDetail.addQuery("trade_id", TradeRecord.sys_id);
                positionDetail.query();
                while (positionDetail.next()) {
                    positionDetail.trade_id = "";
                    positionDetail.trade_base = ""; //Custody Redesign
                    positionDetail.update();
                }
                TradeRecord.position_attribute_sync = "Attribute Sync is in progress";
                TradeRecord.update();
                var sec_acc = TradeRecord.securities_account;
                var countryTerritoryLocationCodes = sec_acc.substring(0, 2);
                var groupMemberIdentification = sec_acc.substring(3, 7);
                var safekeepingAccountIdentifications = sec_acc.substring(8, 22);
                var requestBody = 'countryTerritoryLocationCode=' + countryTerritoryLocationCodes + '&groupMemberIdentification=' + groupMemberIdentification + '&safekeepingAccountIdentifications=' + safekeepingAccountIdentifications + '&hsbcIdentifiers=' + encodeURIComponent(TradeRecord.security_id) + '&reportType=DETAIL';




                var mssPositiononDemandToken = gs.getProperty('x_hsb11_mss_pos.hsbcmss_el_custodyPositionSummaryonDemand_api_token');
                try {
                    var positionOnDemandenv = gs.getProperty('x_hsb11_mss_pos.hsbcmss_el_custodyPositionDetailonDemand_api_url');
                    var r = new sn_ws.RESTMessageV2('x_hsb11_mss_pos.MSS Position Detail OnDemand API Send', 'Fetch Position Detail');
                    r.setStringParameterNoEscape('mssPositionDetail_token', mssPositiononDemandToken);
                    r.setStringParameterNoEscape('eventoutbound_base_uri', positionOnDemandenv);
                    r.setStringParameterNoEscape('requestbody', requestBody);
                    var agentCorrelator = TradeRecord.sys_id + "/TradeForm";
                    r.setEccCorrelator(agentCorrelator); // To Know in the response that we have called from Trade Form
                    r.executeAsync();


                    var requestBodySum = 'countryTerritoryLocationCode=' + countryTerritoryLocationCodes + '&groupMemberIdentification=' + groupMemberIdentification + '&safekeepingAccountIdentifications=' + safekeepingAccountIdentifications + '&hsbcIdentifiers=' + encodeURIComponent(TradeRecord.security_id) + '&reportType=SUMMARY'; //Required For retry

                    //After the API Call we need to add the record in the staging table
                    var createPosOndemand = new GlideRecord('x_hsb11_mss_pos_mss_custody_position_ondemand_staging');
                    createPosOndemand.initialize();
                    createPosOndemand.refresh_start_time = refresh_start_time;
                    createPosOndemand.trade_reference = tradeSysId;
                    createPosOndemand.request_body_for_detail = requestBody;
                    createPosOndemand.request_body_for_summary = requestBodySum;
                    createPosOndemand.insert();
                } catch (apiCallErr) {
                    gs.info("1902 - Script Include - MSSCustodyOnDemandCallUtils (Refresh Holdings Data) - Unexpected error while processing" + apiCallErr.message);
                }

            }
        }
    },
